summary: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan signed a trilateral defense pact dubbed the "Mecca Pact" while Houthi forces escalated attacks on Yemen's Marib city with ballistic missiles and drones for the first time in years. Iran engaged hostile targets at the Strait of Hormuz entrance, prompting a new joint Iran-Oman transit corridor, and Oman-Iran agreed to temporarily reopen the strait to commercial shipping. Israel received a new German submarine and faced planned anti-Israeli protests across Greece.
key_points: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan signed a mutual defense agreement named the Mecca Pact, described as purely defensive and not targeting any specific country. (Source: @New_security8200/203241)
Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles and drones at Marib city, Yemen, marking the first such attack in years and threatening 3 million IDPs. (Source: @shin_persian/8872)
At least 30 Yemeni government fighters killed in Houthi attacks on Saudi-backed positions in Al-Rawik, Al-Abr, and Al-Thaniya using ballistic missiles and drones. (Source: @mamlekate/104095)

Iran engaged hostile targets at the Strait of Hormuz entrance, causing explosions on Qeshm Island, and announced a new central transit corridor under joint Iran-Oman management. (Source: @shin_persian/8865)
Oman and Iran reached a framework deal to temporarily reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial vessels, endorsed by GCC with UN IMO and U.S. involvement expected. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6128)
Israel received a German-built submarine worth approximately 550 million euros; hundreds of IDF artillery shells left unsecured in Upper Galilee for about ten days. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94092)
Pro-Palestinian activists plan a "Day of Rage" with over 40 protest sites across Greece targeting Israeli tourists on Sunday. (Source: @pkpoi/143542)
Saudi sources detected missile and UAV movements potentially inbound, suggesting possible internal Iranian power struggles. (Source: @asafroz/52328)

sections.executive_summary: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan formalized the "Mecca Pact" mutual defense agreement while Houthi forces launched unprecedented ballistic missile and drone strikes on Yemen's Marib city, endangering 3 million displaced persons. Iran conducted military engagements at the Strait of Hormuz entrance, establishing a new joint Iran-Oman transit corridor and agreeing with Oman to temporarily reopen the waterway to commercial shipping. Israel expanded its submarine fleet with a German vessel and contended with unsecured artillery caches and planned anti-Israeli protests in Greece.

points: Explosions on Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz were attributed by IRGC-affiliated Fars News to engagement of hostile targets at the strait entrance; local reports described two loud blasts at 21:43. (Source: @shin_persian/8865, @VahidOnline/77766, @Faytuks_Network/6127)
Iranian jets were observed flying east over northeastern Tehran; the purpose of the flight was not specified in available reports. (Source: @shin_persian/8870)
Iran reportedly launched cruise missiles against vessels accused of violating Strait of Hormuz transit guidelines, according to uncensored security channels. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94091)

IRGC's Fars News announced the elimination of northern and southern Strait of Hormuz corridors, shifting all traffic to a central corridor under joint Iran-Oman management. (Source: @shin_persian/8856)

Oman and Iran agreed on a framework for a temporary deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial vessels, endorsed by GCC members with official announcement involvement expected from the UN International Maritime Organization and the U.S. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6128)
Saudi briefings indicated detection of missile and UAV movements potentially targeting the kingdom, which may reflect internal Iranian power struggles. (Source: @asafroz/52328)
Reports emerged of missile launches from Iran toward the Strait of Hormuz, though details on targets or outcomes were not provided. (Source: @yediotnews25/133682)
Israel received an additional German-built submarine valued at approximately 550 million euros to expand its naval fleet. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94092)

Hundreds of IDF artillery shells were discovered unsecured in an open area of the Upper Galilee, reportedly left behind for about ten days after a military unit departed. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94089)

Pro-Palestinian activists plan a "Day of Rage" on Sunday with at least 40 protest locations across Greece targeting Israeli tourists, including major destinations such as Athens, Thessaloniki, Rhodes, Santorini, Mykonos, Corfu, Crete, Kos, Paros, and Syros. (Source: @pkpoi/143542)
Artillery shelling targeted the outskirts of Zoutar al-Sharqiya toward Mayfadoun, according to multiple local alerts. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383290, @redlinkleb/35202)
A signal scan alert was issued for Beirut's southern suburb with a maximum caution advisory, disseminated via Red Alert Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/35192, @redlinkleb/35193)
A fuel crisis persists in Iraq's Kurdistan Region, with citizens waiting hours on sidewalks for gasoline, reflecting ongoing supply shortages. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87197)

Iraqi Interior Ministry reported a recent rise in fabricated rumors and psychological operations on social media aimed at spreading fear, attributing the campaigns to unidentified actors using fake news, old footage, and misinformation. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87206)

Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan signed a trilateral defense agreement dubbed the "Mecca Pact," stipulating that any military attack against one constitutes an attack against all; Turkish and Reuters sources described it as purely defensive, not directed at any specific country, and not replacing existing bilateral or multilateral agreements. (Source: @New_security8200/203241, @naya_foriraq/87200, @asafroz/52322, @rodast_omiddana/78895, @asafroz/52327, @kianmeli1/90710, @N12chat/221016, @asafroz/52329)

Houthi forces intensified attacks on Yemen's Marib province, launching ballistic missiles and drones at Marib city for the first time in years; the city hosts approximately 3 million internally displaced persons. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78889, @shin_persian/8872)

Houthi attacks killed at least 30 Yemeni government fighters; Houthis claimed targeting Saudi-backed forces in Al-Rawik, Al-Abr, and Al-Thaniya with ballistic missiles and drones. (Source: @mamlekate/104095)
U.S. Treasury Secretary expressed optimism for an imminent ceasefire agreement of 30-60 days and the reopening of maritime corridors. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87209)
Oman and Iran agreed on a framework to temporarily reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial traffic, backed by GCC with UN IMO and U.S. involvement anticipated. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6128)
Saudi briefings indicated detection of missile and UAV movements potentially inbound, possibly linked to internal Iranian power struggles. (Source: @asafroz/52328)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous finalization of the Turkey-Saudi-Pakistan defense pact and the Houthi escalation in Marib signals a broadening of regional alliance structures and proxy warfare. Iran's demonstrated willingness to engage targets at the Strait of Hormuz and restructure maritime corridors indicates a strategy of leveraging chokepoint control amid nuclear and sanctions pressures. The unsecured IDF artillery in northern Israel and planned anti-Israeli protests in Greece reveal vulnerabilities in force protection and diaspora targeting. Saudi detection of inbound missile/UAV movements suggests potential for direct Iranian or proxy strikes on Gulf infrastructure.
sections.regional_response: GCC endorsement of the Oman-Iran Strait of Hormuz framework reflects a pragmatic push to stabilize energy flows despite ongoing tensions. The "Mecca Pact" represents a significant Sunni bloc consolidation, potentially altering deterrence calculations vis-à-vis Iran and its proxies. U.S. Treasury optimism on a 30-60 day ceasefire suggests active diplomatic tracks, possibly linked to maritime security arrangements. Iraq's focus on countering psychological operations highlights internal stability concerns amid external spillover.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Qeshm Island explosions and subsequent IRGC corridor announcement indicate operational changes in Iranian maritime doctrine, possibly testing U.S. and GCC responses. Houthi use of ballistic missiles against Marib after years of restraint suggests improved capabilities or a strategic decision to pressure Saudi-backed forces. The Turkish official emphasis on the pact's defensive nature and non-replacement of existing agreements may signal limits to Ankara's commitment. The IDF ammunition security lapse in Galilee warrants investigation into command accountability and Hezbollah intelligence opportunities.
